content: À gandǝ Absalom a lwa
Pǝlǝa Dauda ramba aburana mǝnana à nda atè ka, sǝ tsǝk amǝ'sàrǝ̀ban mala aá andǝ amǝ'sàrǝ̀ban mala agbǝman amúrià.

Pǝlǝa Dauda tasǝ amǝ'lwa ɓǝà kyane; tsǝk banì mwashat aɓa gauwe tàrú malea aɓata sàrǝ̀ban mala Jowap, sǝ ɓè banì mwashat aɓa gauwe tàrú ka, nda aɓata sàrǝ̀ban mala Abishai muna-ɓwabura mala Zeruya, mǝ'eam Jowap, sǝ tàruia banì mwashat aɓa gauwe tàrú ka, nda aɓata sàrǝ̀ban mala Ittayi ɓwa'Gitti. Pǝlǝa murǝm banggi aburane ama, <<Mim nǝ ɓamúràm gbal ka, mǝ nǝ ká sǝnǝa wun.>>

Sǝama aburane ne wi ama, <<A pà wu nǝ pur ace ká [munǝo] atà sǝm ɗàng. Acemǝnana ɓǝ̀ sǝm ɓang ngga, à pa nǝ̀ falǝnǝ sǝm ɗàng. Sǝ ko ɓǝ̀ gauwa-tsùrú ma'sǝm wù ka, à pa nǝ̀ falǝnǝ sǝm ɗàng. Sǝ we ka, a nda akúnì lakki mala aɓwana ma'sǝm á-lum. Acemani ka, nǝ̀ ɓoaribani wu tasǝa sǝm gbasha nǝ ɓá nggea-là.>>

Pǝlǝa murǝm banggia wia ama, <<Koyagir mǝnana kat, wu sǝni nda ɓoaro kutibani ka, mǝ nǝ pe.>> Nda murǝm cam a nkanggari bankutio [mala Mahanayim], sǝ aburana male kat ging-gya twalkusǝu-anzǝmarǝia sǝ à kǝ kutio aban puro arǝ anggǝsanì malea, mala agbǝman andǝ aá.
Pǝlǝa murǝm tsǝki Jowap andǝ Abishai andǝ Ittai nzongcau ama, <<Lagga man, yì Absalom ngga, wu pangnǝi ɓukɓuk, acem.>> Sǝ amǝ'lwa kat ok cau mǝno murǝm ne amǝ'sàrǝ̀ban, amur Absalom ngga.
Nda amǝ'lwa mala Dauda purî ɓá nggea-là aban ká lwa arǝ Isǝrayila. Mǝnia yì munǝo ka, à pe a ndà-nggun mala bu-nzali Ifǝrem.
Akano ka, amǝ'lwa mala Dauda gandǝ amǝ'lwa mala Isǝrayila. Sǝ aɓwana mǝnana à wal-luia ka, à nda kpǝm. À wal-lú aɓwana á-lumi-ɓari (20,000).

Kara lwa ara ak ɓá nzali kat, sǝ ɓwabundǝa wù kǝ̀rkǝ́r. Yale làkkì mala aɓwana mǝnana à wù atàcau mala agir'mur'mwana mǝnana kum aɓwe aɓa ndà-nggun ngga, kútì làkkì mala aɓwana mǝnana à wal-luia nǝ nggeabyau ka.
Lú mala Absalom

Lang munǝo na arǝ lidǝmba ka, Absalom kya jakiarǝ aburana mala Dauda. Sǝ yì ka, ɓariki nǝ̀ ɓangŋa a nzǝm pǝr-mǝdambǝriso male ace àwá, sǝama lang pǝr-mǝdambǝriso ɓangŋa kúti aɓata ɓè nggun mǝgule mana abu-nggunì na zukǝtǝp ka, kara ɓamúrí gbāli a nre ka abu-nggunì. Sǝ pǝr-mǝdambǝrisonî lidǝmba nǝ o, ɗeki aban gyare a nre bumkuli andǝ nzali.
Mwashat aɓalǝ aburana mala Dauda sǝn mǝnia yì gìr ka, sǝ banggi Jowap ama, <<Ən sǝn Absalom aban gyare arǝ ɓè bu-nggun mǝgule.>>
Jowap pǝlǝa ɗì ɓwabure ama, <<Mana! A sǝni? Palang sǝ a ɓinǝ wal-luí, a túrí a nzali akǝ̀ banì ɗàng? Yale ɓǝ́n pano amǝsǝ bolo-azǝrfa shekel lum andǝ nggur-ɓunu mala amǝ'lwa.>>

Sǝ ɓwabure eari wi ama, <<Ko ɓǝ̀ a pam amǝsǝ bolo-azǝrfa shekel á-mwashat aɓa buam ngga, pà mǝ nǝ tsǝk buam arǝ muna-ɓwabura mala murǝm ɗàng, acemǝnana sǝm kat ka, sǝm oè nǝ kir sǝm, lang murǝm tsǝko nzongcau wunǝ Abishai andǝ Ittai, ama, <Wu tsǝkir mǝlagga, yì Absalom, acem.>
Sǝ ɓǝn mangŋǝna murǝm, ǝn walna-lú muna-ɓwabura male ka, murǝm nǝ̀ yia sǝlǝ nǝnzǝ́mò ama, mǝ nda mǝnana ǝn wal-lú muni ka, sǝ we nǝ nggearǝo ka, awu nǝ nyem.>>

Pǝlǝa Jowap bang ama, <<Mim ngga, pa mǝ nǝ kiɗiki pwari kǝla mǝnia sǝnǝ we ɗàng.>> Pǝlǝa Jowap twal ankongŋo tàrú a bui, wari aban Absalom, mǝnana nda nǝyilǝmu piu, aban gyare a bu-nggun mǝgule ka. Pǝlǝa zuɓiki nǝ ankongŋo mǝno ka a kun-ɓalǝi.
Pǝlǝa lum aɓalǝ amǝ'bwal-agirmunǝo mala Jowap, gumbǝli Absalom a ɓalǝu, à tǝmnggi, sǝ à wal-luí.
Pǝlǝa Jowap twang njawe, nda amǝ'lwa male nyarî pǝrta amǝ'lwa mala Isǝrayila, acemǝnana Jowap tamsǝia ka.
À twal Absalom, à túrí aɓa tūli mǝlime aɓa ndà-nggun, sǝ à ramba atali amurí gum-gum. Sǝ anggo ka, amǝ Isǝrayila kat ɓangŋǝna, koyanale ka umǝna a ɓala male.

(Mǝnana Absalom malaká wù raka, tsǝkî ɓamúrì nggea tali, a Ɓangŋaban mala Murǝm, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ duk gir'lǝmndǝa ace lidǝmba mala lullǝi ka. Acemǝnana pakɗenyicau ama, <<Mim ngga, ǝn panǝ muna-ɓwabura mana nǝ lidǝmba nǝ lullǝam a ɓanza, mana à nǝ̀ nggǝ ɗenyinǝ mim nǝi ka ɗàng.>> Pǝlǝa tunǝ nggea tali mǝno nǝ lullǝì. Anggo sǝ à kǝ tunǝi ama, <Nggea tali mala Absalom,> ba yalung.)
Cau mala lú mala Absalomandǝ bumkiɗikea mala murǝm Dauda
Pǝlǝa Ahima'az muna-ɓwabura mala Zadok bang ama, <<Came, ɓǝn ɓangŋa, ɓǝn kyan nǝ bǝsacau man aban murǝm; mǝ nǝ nggá ne wi ama Yahweh kasǝna-ɓashi, angŋamurí a bù aɓi-mǝbura.>>

Pǝlǝa Jowap ne wi ama, <<A nda mǝnana awu nǝ ká nǝ mǝnia yì bǝsacau yalung ngga ɗàng. Awu nǝ gandǝnǝ ká nǝi wi nǝ cê a ɓè pwari, sǝama dumǝna púp a pà wu nǝ ká nǝ cê yalung ɗàng, acemǝnana muna-ɓwabura mala murǝm [yì Absalom] ngga, pàngŋǝ̀nà-lú.>>
Pǝlǝa Jowap ne ɓè ɓwa'Kush ama, <<We, kya banggi murǝm gìr mǝnana a sǝni ka.>> Pǝlǝa ɓwa'Kush ɓun aɓadǝm Jowap, sǝ ɓangŋa aban o.

Pǝlǝa Ahima'az, muna-ɓwabura mala Zadok ne Jowap ɗǝm ama, <<Ko palang le ka, ida, came mǝ ɓangŋa atà ɓwa'Kush mǝno.>> Sǝ Jowap pe wi eare ama, <<Muna-ɓwabura mem, ace mana sǝ a kǝ earce ama a nǝ ká? We ka, a panǝ kǝ tangnakusǝu mǝnana awu nǝ̀ kum ace mǝnia yì bǝsacau ka ɗang.>>
Pǝlǝa Ahima'az bang ama, <<Ko palang le ka, mǝ nǝ ɓangŋa, mǝ nǝ ká.>> Pǝlǝa Jowap bang ama, <<Ɓangŋa!>> Pǝlǝa Ahima'az ɓangŋa, um nǝ njar ɓawanban, sǝ ɓangŋa akì ɓwa'Kush dǝmba.

Lang Dauda na ban do anre kúnɓala mana nǝ ɓalǝu andǝ mana nǝ nza mala nggea-lê ka, mǝ'sǝn múr nggea-là eau a kuli amur kún nggea-là nǝ rǝ sheran. Lang loasǝ mǝsǝi sǝnban ngga, kara sǝn ɓè ɓwabura aban ɓang nǝmurǝi aban yiu nǝbania.
Pǝlǝa mǝ'sǝn múr nggea-là tunǝ murǝm sǝ banggi wi gìr mǝnana sǝn ngga. Murǝm pǝlǝa bang ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ ɓwe na nǝmurǝi ka, dumǝna púp ndanǝ bǝsacau.>> Sǝ ɓwe kǝ gbàshìban tù kǝ yiu.

Pǝlǝa mǝ'sǝn múr nggea-là sǝn ɓè ɓwabura aban yiu nǝ mire, pǝlǝa tunǝ mǝ'yál kunɓala sǝ bang ama, <<Sǝni, ɓè ɓwabura nia ɗǝm kǝ yiu nǝ mire nǝmurǝi ka!>> Pǝlǝa murǝm bang ama, <<Yì gbal ka, dumǝna púp ndaban yinǝ bǝsacau.>>
Pǝlǝa mǝ'sǝn múr nggea-là na ama, <<Ən nggǝ sǝni, ɓwa mǝdǝmbe ka, kǝ ɓangŋa kǝla Ahima'az muna-ɓwabura mala Zadok.>> Murǝm pǝlǝa bang ama, <<Yì ka, ɓwa mǝɓoarne na. Ndaban yinǝ bǝsacau mǝɓoarne.>>

Pǝlǝa Ahima'az loasǝ gì tunǝ murǝm sǝ ne wi ama, <<Koman kat ka, nda pepè!>> Pǝlǝa yì ka, ɓùn aɓadǝm murǝm nǝ ɓamǝsǝi a nzali, sǝ bang ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ ɓwangsǝban pa aban Yahweh Ɓakuli mô, mǝnana pàna amǝ'mgbicau a ɓabuo ka, yià mǝnana à loasǝ buia arǝ ɓwamǝgule mem murǝm ngga.>>

Pǝlǝa murǝm ɗìban ama, <<Nggearǝ lagga, yì Absalom ngga, nda jam le?>> Pǝlǝa Ahima'az pa eare ama, <<Lang Jowap guro mò tasǝam ama ɓǝn yiu ka, ǝn sǝn ban ngga, zurina kǝ̀rkǝ́r. Sǝama, ǝn súrǝ̀ mana girni na ɗang.>>
Pǝlǝa murǝm bang ama, <<Nyar a nkanggariban, kúndǝô.>> Nda yi ka, nyar a nkanggariban, sǝ cam a kǝ banì.
Pǝlǝa ɓwa'Kush yi tusǝo, sǝ bang ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule mem, murǝm, ok mǝnia yì bǝsacau mǝɓoarne ka! Yahweh amsǝno yalung, a ɓabù aɓwana mǝnana kat à mgbicau arǝò ka.>>

Pǝlǝa murǝm ɗì ɓwa'Kush ama, <<Mǝlagga Absalom ngga, nda jam le?>> Pǝlǝa ɓwa'Kush pa eare ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ aɓi-mǝbura kat mala ɓwamǝgule mem murǝm, andǝ aɓwana mǝnana kat à mgbicau arǝì ace ɓealɓikea ka, ɓǝà pa kǝla mǝno yì lagga ka!>>

Pǝlǝa murǝm ngga, rǝì twal ɓǝla. Sǝ eauwe, wari a kurǝm-kuli mana amur kunɓala ka, ɓua kàm. A njar aban ká ka, kǝ ɓua kǝ na ama: <<Oi, muna-ɓwabura mem Absalom! Muna-ɓwabura mem, muna-ɓwabura mem Absalom! Ɓǝ̀ pǝlǝa ama, mǝ nda mǝnana ǝn wú a kunio ka, ɓǝ́ ɓoarna, oi muna-ɓwabura mem Absalom, muna-ɓwabura mem!>>

footnotes.text: Absalom tsǝk nggea tali mǝnia ka a bàkú mǝnana malaká ɓǝl amuna-burana male raka (2Sam 14:27); ko à wukina sǝ tsǝk talinì.
